material-volume-reporting.rationale: This is a core, widely referenced reporting capability for collection analysis and planning, including point-in-time and category breakdowns.

shelf-space-utilization-report.rationale: It is a heavily requested consortium-level analytical report needed for periodic collection and space reviews, including date filtering and comparison views.

branch-capacity-interface.rationale: A consortium-wide capacity/utilization dashboard with drilldown, filtering, sorting, and export is essential for operational decision-making.

item-transfer-batch-utility.rationale: Batch transfers with previews, permissions, audit history, efficiency, and integrity protections are fundamental to moving items safely at scale.

in-transit-and-missing-damaged-reports.rationale: Operational correctness depends on consolidated missing/damaged/in-transit reporting with configurable thresholds and branch/system aggregation.

purging-and-weeding-utility.rationale: Purging/weeding requires safety (previews/confirmations/undo), auditability, and guardrails like last-copy checks, making it essential.

deletions-audit-and-reports.rationale: Deletion logging/reporting for compliance and auditing is a core control requirement, with tracking of denied attempts.

patron-characteristics-and-demographics-.rationale: Frequently sourced and explicitly requires privacy-protecting demographic reporting with flexible filtering logic, indicating core functional scope.

inactive-patrons-report.rationale: Strongly defined and useful for outreach with exports and exclusions, but it is less central than core reporting/transfer/audit capabilities.

uncataloged-material-inventory.rationale: Important for operational inventory of uncataloged items and inclusion in circulation stats, but it appears in fewer sources.

transactions-history-and-aggregation.rationale: Long-term transactional retention plus indefinite aggregates and rich grouping/snapshotting are foundational for reporting and audit needs.

detailed-transaction-counts.rationale: Counting circulation/check-in/out/holds with breakdowns is a core prerequisite for many collection and operational analytics.

predefined-and-board-reports.rationale: Canned executive/operational reports improve governance and consistency, but can be partially worked around versus core reporting infrastructure.

report-writer-features.rationale: A web-based query/report writer with saved queries and boolean/regex filtering is central to enabling the other reporting requirements.

report-templates-and-permissions.rationale: Template management and fine-grained permissions are essential for safe delegation, governance, and controlled access to reporting.

report-scheduling-queue-and-priority.rationale: Scheduling, queuing, status visibility, cancellation, and prioritization are important for operations but are less foundational than core report/query/reporting.

report-output-formats-and-delivery.rationale: Multi-format export plus delivery with selection-criteria metadata is required so reports are usable and auditable downstream.

real-time-and-historical-reporting.rationale: Reproducible point-in-time/historical views with snapshot/replica support is core to correct operational decision-making and audits.

marc-and-field-level-reporting.rationale: Field-level/MARC reporting unlocks advanced cataloging and weeding analyses, but may depend on other reporting foundations being in place first.

data-quality-reports.rationale: Important for catalog integrity and migration QA with scheduled/on-demand execution, though not as operationally central as core circulation reporting.

financial-reporting-and-ledger.rationale: Financial reports plus an auditable ledger are essential for reconciliation, accounting retention, and compliance.

audit-and-compliance.rationale: Audit trails/retention and privacy-preserving reporting are cross-cutting legal/compliance constraints that the system must meet.

technical-environment-and-compatibility.rationale: Platform/browser/DB constraints and integrity-preserving relational reporting are core implementation constraints for deployment feasibility.

non-disruptive-reporting-and-replicas.rationale: Non-disruptive background processing (and optional replicas) is critical to ensure reporting does not harm production operations.

development-and-training-environments.rationale: Separation and migratability of dev/training environments is important for safe rollout, but typically not as critical as production correctness/compliance.

role-based-access-and-authentication.rationale: RBAC with auditable authentication is required to control access to sensitive reporting and administrative actions.

online-help-and-error-reporting.rationale: Help and diagnostics reduce training burden and improve usability, but can be delivered with lighter scope after core reporting functionality.

data-specifications-and-process-document.rationale: Providing complete data specs and process documentation is important for integrations/report interpretability, though it is often delivered alongside or after core logic.

enterprise-integration-and-opac-interfer.rationale: Secure, auditable integrations plus guarantees that reporting does not constrain or degrade OPAC are essential system-level constraints.

ui-quick-access-and-tooltips.rationale: Usability enhancements like quick access and tooltips are beneficial but not critical to system correctness or core reporting.

null-and-blank-field-handling.rationale: Explicit null/blank handling improves report correctness and consumer understanding, but may be partially mitigated by conventions in early releases.

survey-name-filtering.rationale: Name-to-ID resolution is a usability improvement that can be worked around by using internal IDs.

last-edit-date-visibility.rationale: Specific metadata visibility on item reports is useful for staff workflows but is narrowly scoped and appears in only one source.

support-large-consortium-scale.rationale: Scalability for many locations and millions of circulations is a core non-functional requirement underpinning feasible performance.

standard-operational-report-templates.rationale: Built-in operational templates are valuable for adoption and consistency but less essential than the core report/template/permission framework.

patron-behavior-analytics.rationale: Analytics/trend indicators are desirable for strategic insights but are not as foundational as core reporting, auditing, and operational exports.

overdue-items-with-contact-report.rationale: A useful predefined outreach report, but it depends on other reporting and privacy controls and is only mentioned in one source.

claims-returned-report.rationale: A specialized predefined report with security controls is valuable, but it is not core infrastructure.

collection-age-by-call-number.rationale: This advanced weeding/collection-development report is helpful but appears only once and can be deferred behind core reporting capabilities.

enterprise-integration-and-opac-interact.rationale: Default priority (not assigned by the model).
